description: Create an invite link for a channel. Defaults are deliberate: expires in 24 hours, unlimited uses. A never-expiring invite must be asked for explicitly with max_age_seconds 0.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

max_age_seconds.description: Lifetime in seconds, 0 for never. Default 86400 (24h).

temporary.description: Members who join leave again when they disconnect.

name: create_invite
title: Create invite
